productSupportClaimScope: Pinned Next.js 15.5.26 browser-worker CLI/runtime with version-matched WASM SWC under the release CSP. Native .node addons and arbitrary Next versions remain outside scope.

scope.goal: Maintain the pinned Next.js full runtime as a strict-CSP browser-worker product surface.

browserWorker.reason: The complete integrity-pinned Next 15.5.26 graph passes dev/HMR, build, start/restart, feature, recovery, teardown, and heap-budget checks in strict-CSP Chrome.

security.reason: Pinned Next 15.5.26 and version-matched WASM SWC satisfy the maintained September 2026 security baseline.

capabilities.reason: NextProductWorkflow serves app/**/page.tsx with layout wrapping, next/link navigation, and save-triggered preview refresh in the product IDE.
Preview path maps to app route segments (e.g. /about -> app/about/page.tsx).
Adapter writes out/index.html smoke artifacts for product build button.

capabilities.command: next dev | next build | next start
capabilities.reason: The pinned Next 15.5.26 distribution and real CLI dev, build, and start paths pass in strict-CSP Chrome.
The real Next 15.5.26 development server compiles the App Router with version-matched WASM SWC, serves it, and applies a real HMR edit.
The real Next 15.5.26 build emits BUILD_ID, RSC/client manifests, middleware and Edge bundles, prerender metadata, server chunks, and production assets.
May become supportable after WASM SWC and build-time filesystem contracts are verified; runtime server features remain out of scope.
Native platform packages and native .node addons are outside the browser runtime support scope.
The integrity-pinned, version-matched @next/swc-wasm-nodejs 15.5.26 transform path passes real next dev and next build in strict-CSP Chrome.
Production RSC manifests are emitted and a real Server Action POST returns the expected 303 action redirect.
Middleware response mutation and an Edge-runtime route execute through the production server fixture.
ISR transitions from stale to regenerated cache content and Image Optimization returns byte-exact PNG data.

gate.supportDecision: Pinned Next.js 15.5.26 full CLI/runtime is product-supported under the exact release CSP with integrity-pinned, version-matched WASM SWC. Native .node SWC and arbitrary Next versions remain unsupported.
